summary: Nippon Ichi's musical RPG series, known in Japan as Marl Kingdom, spanning the original Rhapsody trilogy and a historical mobile side entry.

entries.title: Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure

emulation.notes: Use PC for the main run.

primary.why: The Windows release is the modern standalone route for the first Rhapsody, avoiding the DS version's removed/absent advertised bonus scenarios and handheld audio compromises.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam version on Windows; use the PlayStation original only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern rerelease, not a ground-up remake.
